chunks: So We seized him and his armies, and threw them into the sea, for he was worthy of blame.
ai.seo_question: What happened to Pharaoh and his army according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Adh-Dhariyat underscores the comprehensive nature of divine retribution, where Pharaoh and his entire army are cast into the sea as a direct consequence of their persistent arrogance and denial of truth. The term 'Mulim' (fully deserving of blame) emphasizes that their punishment was not arbitrary but the inevitable result of their own actions, serving as a timeless lesson for believers regarding the fate of tyrants.
